question: Does transload.me still credit a 100-150 MB trial on registration, and does the speed run at the home page's above 1 MB/s or the per-host pages' 5 Mbit/sec?
why: The trial text of the 150 MB and 100 MB blocks is not on the home page as served on 2026-11-03, the two speed statements disagree, and only a registered account shows the live tariff and speed.
